lines: +# Changelog
+## v1.0.0 (milestone m14) -- first release of the ShopFlow analytics project
+- 9 sources (4 raw schemas) with freshness on orders, payments, events and shipments
+- 9 staging models, 3 intermediate models (1 ephemeral), 9 marts (1 Python model)
+- 2 seeds, 2 YAML snapshots, 4 unit tests, 91 data tests
+- public models with enforced contracts: fct_orders, dim_customers (v2, v1 deprecated 2027-06-30)
+- 2 exposures (weekly revenue, customer segments)
+- slim CI on pull requests (state:modified+, --defer, --empty)
+## Known data issues (tests set to warn, see Chapter 26)
+- shopflow_app.customers: 4 old copies of customer rows (removed in staging)
+- web_analytics.events: duplicated event_id sent by the tracker (removed in staging)
+- payments_provider.payments: payment 3170 has a negative amount (ignored in int_payments__per_order)
+- shopflow_app.orders: order 1847 points to customer 9999, who does not exist (ticket APP-412)
# the profile (connection) defined in ~/.dbt/profiles.yml
profile: 'shopflow'
+# fail fast with a clear message if someone runs the project with another dbt version
+flags:
+  send_anonymous_usage_stats: false
model-paths: ["models"]
analysis-paths: ["analyses"]
test-paths: ["tests"]
